notes.title: Thanks for the 50 reviews! 🎉
notes.content:
Many thanks to all of you for your support and opinions! Thanks to your feedback, I've picked up lots of good ideas and will continue to improve the game. Every comment counts and helps make Stick Tongue even better.

Don't hesitate to share the game around you and keep leaving your reviews, it helps enormously! 🚀

[img]https://c.tenor.com/LIRTZuSVaDYAAAAd/tenor.gif[/img]

notes.title: Stick Tongue is finally available! 🐸🔥
notes.content:
It's time for the wildest adventure yet! Stick Tongue promises hours of fun and rage 😈. Take advantage of a -20% discount for the first 10 days!

🔥 Challenge your friends, leave a review and show who's got the sharpest tongue! 🔥

[img]https://c.tenor.com/c9QZfM8L8aQAAAAd/tenor.gif[/img]

notes.title: New update - Chill mode, inverted camera and more!
notes.content:
✅ Reverse camera option
✅ Chill mode added (full version)
✅ New hidden button to make the frog scream 🐸
✅ Improved tongue physics
✅ Texture bugs fixed
✅ On keyboard, the R key is now used to respawn

notes.title: The Stick Tongue demo is now available! 🐸✨
notes.content:
The Stick Tongue demo is finally available! 🐸💨 Enjoy it from February 24 to March 3 during Steam Neo Fest. Test the gameplay, take on the challenges and leave a positive review and a comment to help us improve the game before its release.

Add Stick Tongue to your wishlist and enjoy! 🎯🔥

notes.title: 🐸 Stick Tongue takes part in Steam Neo Fest! 🎮
notes.content:
Good news! Stick Tongue will be present at Steam Neo Fest from February 24 to March 3, 2025. 🎉 You'll be able to try out the free demo and discover Frogus' unique gameplay! 🐸

Add Stick Tongue to your wishlist now to make sure you don't miss a thing! 🚀

notes.title: Demo Available 🐸🔥
notes.content: Good news! 🎉 The Stick Tongue demo will be available for free on Steam starting February 24. Come test the game before its official release on March 7 and participate in the Steam Next Fest to discover its full potential! Add it to your wishlist now and get ready! 💚🐸
